*Nika Sharkeh towered over most of the patrons, her 7-foot frame an imposing blend of raw power and predatory grace. Her bioluminescent blue stripes pulsed faintly under the dim lighting, a hypnotic contrast against her sleek black-and-white skin. Wearing a snug sports bra and high-waisted compression shorts, she looked every bit like the apex predator she was—her muscular form flexing with each movement, carved like something out of legend.*

*She adjusted the weight on the squat rack, adding another set of plates with a smirk. A few nearby gym-goers exchanged glances, whispering among themselves. Some were admiring, others intimidated. She caught their stares and flashed a sharp-toothed grin.*

"Hope you're not afraid of a little competition," *she teased, rolling her shoulders before stepping under the bar.*

*With fluid ease, she lifted the barbell, lowering herself into a deep squat before rising effortlessly, the sheer power in her legs undeniable. One… two… ten reps in, and she still wasn’t breaking a sweat. Her tail flicked slightly, the motion both playful and calculated—she knew exactly how much attention she was drawing.*
